event.command:
cd /home/skogix/skogai/projects/config && git add -A && git commit -q -F - <<'EOF'
Move env docs to skogai-cli; globals to atuin

ENV.md and ENV-HANDOVER.md now live in skogai-cli/docs, next to the
skogai CLI that enforces them.

fish/config.fish no longer sets globals with set -gx. EDITOR, VISUAL,
PAGER, SKOGAI_CONFIG_DIR, ARGC_COMPLETIONS_ROOT, ARGC_COMPLETIONS_PATH
and PNPM_HOME are atuin dotfiles vars now (ENV.md: global non-secret
values go to atuin). The pnpm PATH entry uses fish_add_path.

SKOGAI_CONFIG_DIR moves from /home/skogix/skogai/config, which does not
exist, to the install path /home/skogix/.config/skogai/.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Q2ra8dYSiCURcb6QSJbe7r
EOF
git log --oneline -1; cd ../skogai-cli && git add -A && git commit -q -F - <<'EOF'
Add skogai CLI with env module

Stdlib-only Python package with the skogai command:

- skogai path [area] [components...]: resolved directory, no trailing slash
- skogai env --explain: each variable and the tier that resolved each area
- skogai env check: naming, overlap and secret findings; exit 1 on error

Resolution order follows docs/ENV.md: SKOGAI_<AREA>_..._DIR, then the XDG
base directory, then a default under $HOME. The check reads atuin var
names only, never values.

The canonical skogai home name (SKOGAI_DIR here) is still open in
docs/ENV-HANDOVER.md; ROOT_VARS in areas.py holds the leaning.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Q2ra8dYSiCURcb6QSJbe7r
EOF
git log --oneline -1; git status --short
